input_fields.name: body_reference
input_fields.description: One current body whose kernel volume is requested.

result_fields.name: volume_record
result_fields.description: Measured volume, unit, body identity, and measurement provenance.

procedure: Resolve one current body and verify the requested unit.
Read the kernel volume once and preserve sign/validity information returned by the API.
Return volume_record and measurement_status; do not replace an unavailable value with zero.
Leave all topology and persistence state unchanged.
rejection_rules: Reject ambiguous/invalid body, incompatible unit, or nonfinite volume.
Reject visual volume estimates or a value copied from another body.
Do not repair an open body inside this measurement atom.
